evidence_text: Randomised; PFS improved with vemurafenib: HR 0.50, P=0.001. Simultaneous inhibition of EGFR and BRAF combined with irinotecan is effective in BRAFV600E-mutated CRC.
notes: Biomarker-selected (BRAF V600E). First public result was the 2017 meeting abstract.

evidence_text: Primary: MMR at 12 mo. Hypothesis 10% (imatinib) vs 25% (dasatinib), two-sided alpha 0.05. Result 29% vs 13%, P=0.005. The primary endpoint of MMR rate after 12 months was met.
notes: Randomised phase 2b, 2:1. Comparator is an active drug (imatinib).

evidence_text: Primary: confirmed ORR in HRD+, platinum-sensitive, PARPi-naive, 3-4 prior lines. 13/47 (28%), P=0.00053 vs null ORR <=10%.
notes: Start 2015 = v9 embargo year: trial may be excluded from modelling though the label stands. Primary population was amended during the trial.

evidence_text: Single-arm exploratory; primary ORR 41.2% (95% CI 18.4-67.1), n=17 evaluable. No pre-specified threshold in record.
reason_if_unknown: No pre-specified success criterion found (record; no matching paper).
notes: PMID 24419420 is a different pemetrexed/cisplatin trial (stage IB-IIIA; pCR endpoint) - do not use.
